notes.title: Sleepy Heroes 0.92.1 | First Day Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173509/ede332942140c6915c695f3e68716384f4d663c0.png[/img][h1]Bug & Crash Fixes[/h1]
Draw Pile crash bug fix
Paperclip Trinket crash bug fix
Draw Pile invisible bug fix

[h1]QoL & Polish[/h1]
Lots of text has changed
Hero and Monster Jump animations cleaned

[h1]New Content[/h1]
12 new Quest added

[h1]Balances[/h1]

[h3]Trinkets[/h3]
Piggy and Anti Piggy neutralizes each other
GLUE: Everytime a Monster takes Poison Damage, it loses [strike]2[/strike] ➝ 5 Max HP
Weakened Player Damage [strike]round down[/strike] ➝ round up
GREEN COAT: When you take Damage, apply [strike]1[/strike] ➝ 3 Poison
PINATA: Every Monster starts the Battle with [strike]1[/strike] ➝ 2 Mark
POINTY: When a Knife or Pencil Symbol is removed, deal [strike]1[/strike] ➝ 3 Direct Damage

[h3]Cards[/h3]
BULLY: [strike]Reflect[/strike] ➝  Reflect Reflect Reflect
BULLY+: [strike]Reflect Reflect[/strike] ➝ Reflect Reflect Reflect Reflect
T RULER: [strike]Corrupt Tear Reflect Reflect[/strike] ➝ Tear Reflect Reflect Reflect
T RULER+: [strike]Corrupt Tear Reflect Reflect Reflect[/strike] ➝ Tear Reflect Reflect Reflect Reflect Reflect

[h3]Symbols[/h3]
Pencil: Deal [strike]1[/strike] ➝ 2 Damage and gain [strike]1[/strike] ➝ 2 Block, x2 with Trash

notes.title: Sleepy Heroes Early Access Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173509/3bd7b2658806f5011db67f60d3c610859df53cc2.gif[/img]

[h3]Sleepy Heroes Early Access[/h3]
Do you like Roguelike Deckbuilder games? How about sitting back and watching your build work? Constantly trying new synergies with different mechanics?

This Friday, Sleepy Heroes is coming to you with Early Access!

Sort cards with dozens of different symbols
Finish your round for your ghost friend to play
Watch the cards being played one by one
Challenge the creatures of the night with a succession of cards!

[h3]What awaits you?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173509/8d6b558c09ccb6e60b02f9a2a064ff1d65cb43a6.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Unique tour mechanics
[*]Cards used like puzzle pieces
[*]Randomly generated map
[*]2 Boss fight
[*]Temporary and Permanent card selection mechanics
[*]2 different Heroes and more than 10 Builds
[*]9 different difficulty modes
[*]Lo-Fi and Chill game streaming
[/list]

[h3]Early Access Process[/h3]
From this point on, Sleepy Heroes will evolve with you. We will be able to understand how the full game will look more or less in this version. Cards, mechanics, 2 different Heroes and many other things will be brought to you and we will take a much longer path with your feedback.

Hope you have fun Heroes!

- Pinokyon Team
